correct.description: Body forms a straight line from ankles to shoulders (forearm or high plank), hips level -- neither sagging nor piked

common_errors.description: Hips drop below straight-line body position, loading the lower back
Hips raised too high -- reduces core engagement

reference_keypoints._landmark_limitation_note: "neck alignment" (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §3's key-faults column) is intentionally NOT a common_error here -- there is no head/neck landmark in detector/keypoint_map.py's POSE_MODEL_LANDMARKS (shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle/heel/toe only), so it can't be measured without inventing a landmark the pipeline doesn't have. Flagged for whoever scopes Stage 5b, not silently dropped.

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: movement_type is "hold", not "rep" -- graded on hold-quality over time, not a rep count (EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §5). This key is still named rep_counting for schema-shape consistency with every other exercise contract; its content is hold-specific.

coaching_cues.setup: Forearms and toes on the ground, body straight
coaching_cues.execution: Brace your core, keep hips level and still
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Good hold. Next time, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.hip_sag: Lift your hips, engage your core
flag_cues.hip_pike: Lower your hips to a straight line

back_injury.modification: Reduce hold time. Try a shorter, more frequent hold, or an incline plank against a wall.

shoulder_injury.modification: Use a forearm plank instead of a high plank. Reduce hold time.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding during the hold -- breathe steadily throughout.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. rotation/twist, gradual drift not caught by the instantaneous threshold). Cannot override the deterministic hold-quality gate or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.
